Securidge Trace — PC activity review tool
=========================================

What it does
  Collects activity traces left on a Windows PC into one easy report. No installation.
  - Devices: USB storage, phones, Bluetooth
  - Files: files opened (shortcuts, jump lists), folders opened (incl. USB, network, phones), deleted files (Recycle Bin)
  - Programs: programs run and run counts (Prefetch, BAM, UserAssist), executables present (Amcache)
  - Network: wired/wireless networks, Remote Desktop access, data sent per program (SRUM)
  - Web: visits and downloads (Chrome, Edge, Whale, Brave, Vivaldi, Firefox)
  - Clearing: event log clearing, clock changes, cleanup tools run

How to use (usually 1–3 minutes)
  1. Copy the extracted folder to a USB drive (running from USB is recommended).
  2. Double-click SecuridgeTrace.exe on the PC to check and allow administrator rights.
  3. Click the round [Start] button, confirm the details, tick "I am authorized to check this PC", then [Start check].
  4. Click [Open report]. Use [Print / Save as PDF] at the top of the report.
     Each check writes both an English and a Korean report; the button at the top right switches language.
     Detail sections open with [Show details]; printing always includes every section.

If "Windows protected your PC" appears
  Click [More info] → [Run anyway]. It appears for new unsigned programs.

Where results are saved
  In the "data" folder next to the program. Use [History] to reopen, recreate in another language or delete.

Results
  Nothing notable found / Caution / Needs review / Undetermined (run again as administrator)

Notes
  - For first-pass review. No record does not mean no activity.
  - Names and content of files sent, printing and screenshots cannot be seen.

Command line
  trace.exe check --i-am-authorized --customer "Company" --analyst "Name"
  trace.exe analyze --input E:\ --output D:\results
  trace.exe --help
